repos_data.description: LLM guardrails & prompt injection detection for Python. Auto-instruments LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI, LiteLLM + 8 more frameworks. PII masking, toxicity detection, policy CI/CD. One line, zero code changes.
Credential isolation for AI agents. Local-first transparent proxy — your agent never sees your API keys.
Open, audit-grade agentic data quality framework with portable industry packs
Local-first policy gateway for coding agents. Allow, review, or block MCP, shell, SQL, GitHub, and HTTP actions with scoped credentials and signed evidence.
Rollback and safety for AI coding agents and vibe coders: flag risky changes and restore project files, including uncommitted work, to their pre-session state.
Policy enforcement layer for AI coding agents — briefing gates, team memory, Git/CI checks
Long-term memory for AI-coded codebases. A git blame for AI agents — but for the why. MCP server that captures the agent's reasoning live, in context, as each change is made. Local SQLite, zero deps.

Behavioral Verification Infrastructure — MCP-native intelligence layer for autonomous software correctness. 17 MCP tools, semantic workflow grouping, drift detection, counterfactual mode, adversarial probes, confidence half-life. Local-first, MIT, OSS.

Local guardrails for AI coding agents. Wraps any MCP server and blocks destructive tool calls — DROP TABLE, rm -rf, force-push, unscoped UPDATE/DELETE — before they execute. Free, open-source, runs entirely on your machine.
Local-first, eval-first memory for long-horizon AI agents — no LLM at ingest. Python SDK + MCP server with source-traceable recall, belief revision, selective forgetting, and reproducible benchmarks.
ThumbGate Pre-Action Checks self-improve from ranked lessons and repeated failures, hard-block detected secret leaks, and block matches in strict mode.
AI Citation Toolkit — 14 MCP tools to audit, score, and rewrite web pages for AI-citation eligibility (AEO/GEO/LLM visibility). Read-only, no API keys, works in any MCP client.
